title: Peanut Butter and Jelly Wings
description: These Asian-inspired wings offer some fun new flavors while using some familiar ingredients.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons Sriracha sauce, or to taste

steps.text: Combine peanut butter, lime juice, soy sauce, honey, Sriracha, cilantro stems, garlic, and ginger in a food processor and blend until smooth. If sauce seems too thick, add 1 tablespoon water.
Stir together raspberry jam and chili paste in a small bowl until fully combined.
Toss cooked wings in peanut sauce until fully coated. Drizzle with raspberry-chili sauce.

video.description: If you’re looking for a crowd pleasing appetizer for the Big Game, we’ve got you covered. In this video, Annie shows us a delicious and fun twist on traditional wings - Peanut Butter and Jelly Wings aka PB&J Wings! These wings are the perfect combination of savory and sweet, using ingredients like peanut butter, low sodium soy sauce, honey, ginger, garlic, cilantro, lime juice, and sriracha. The wings are first fried until crispy and then coated in a creamy peanut sauce. To finish, they are drizzled with a sweet and spicy chili raspberry sauce, giving them an extra pop of flavor. These wings are a great option for the game day, a party, or just a fun dinner at home. So let's get cooking!
